name: Stout to Kadrell
summary: A cask of Rejold Barleybrew’s new Shimmer Stout is headed east to Mountaineer Kadrell in Loch Modan. You carry it from Dun Morogh’s frozen heights to the warmer valley.

sections.title: A Taste Beyond the Mountains
sections.body: From Dun Morogh’s eastern border post, Mountaineer Barleybrew watches the mountain passes and the kin guarding neighboring lands. The Mountaineers’ patrols can be cold and grueling, and a stout heart calls for stout drink. Rejold’s new Shimmer Stout is too good to keep in Dun Morogh. Barleybrew wants an honest opinion from a fellow patrolman, so he sends a cask east with travelers bound for Loch Modan.

sections.title: The Road to Thelsamar
sections.body: For young dwarven and gnomish adventurers, the road to Loch Modan is a rite of passage after their early days in Dun Morogh’s snowbound crags. You pass southeast through the South Gate Outpost, then follow long tunnels cut through the mountain bedrock. Beyond them lies Loch Modan’s warmer, wooded basin. Mountaineer Kadrell patrols the road through Thelsamar. He pauses to tap the cask and finds that Barleybrew’s new recipe has an astonishing kick.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell is a dwarven defender in Loch Modan. He patrols the central road through Thelsamar.
Shimmer Stout is a potent ale brewed by Rejold Barleybrew at the Brewnall Village distillery in western Dun Morogh. Its strength brings a head-spinning kick and invigorating warmth.

faq.q: How do I reach Loch Modan from Dun Morogh?
aliases: how to get to loch modan
faq.answer: From Dun Morogh’s eastern guard posts, head southeast through the mountain tunnels past the South Gate. In Loch Modan, follow the road as it forks northeast toward Thelsamar by the lake.

faq.q: Why does Barleybrew want Kadrell to try the beer?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Barleybrew and Mountaineer Kadrell are fellow members of the dwarven Mountaineers. Impressed by his brother’s new recipe, Barleybrew wants his comrade in the neighboring valley to try it.

faq.q: What does Kadrell think of the brew?
faq.answer: Kadrell is astonished by the stout’s strength. He swears by Magni’s beard that it spins his head and lightens his limbs until he feels he can fly.

faq.q: Does this quest lead to further tasks?
faq.answer: Delivering the cask concludes the Shimmer Stout chain begun in Dun Morogh. It brings travelers to Thelsamar, where many duties await across Loch Modan.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you carry mountain ale across territorial lines, connecting Brewnall Village’s brewers with the patrols guarding Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance traveler, you follow the road from Dun Morogh’s snowy reaches into Loch Modan’s broader frontier.
